title: Use Seedance 2.0 Mini in CapCut for fast image-to-video drafts instead of…
content:
Use Seedance 2.0 Mini in CapCut for fast image-to-video drafts instead of defaulting to the heaviest model for every idea.  
Generate multiple short ad variations from a single product photo (close-ups, teasers, clean reveals, dramatic cuts) using Seedance 2.0 Mini, then move up to Seedance 2.0 if you need a heavier pass.  
Keep promo concepts generic in your prompts (avoid teams/players/logos/match footage/tournament references) to capture the vibe without using protected IP.  
After generating in CapCut, immediately trim the clip and add music, pacing adjustments, text, subtitles, and a CTA inside the same CapCut workflow.
